{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_parsed'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter: completed orders AND not internal test orders (revenue_parsed != 999999.99)
completed_not_test = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_parsed'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = completed_not_test['revenue_parsed'].sum()

print(f"Number of completed orders (excluding test): {len(completed_not_test)}")
print(f"Total revenue: {total_revenue:.2f}")"}
